title.en: All-white jury selected in murder trial over killing at 2025 Texas high school
title.zh: 得州高中凶杀案审判选出全白人陪审团

summary.en: An all-white jury has been selected for a murder trial in Texas. The case involves Karmelo Anthony, who is Black and accused of stabbing Austin Metcalf, who was white, following a high school track meet in an affluent Dallas suburb.
summary.zh: 得克萨斯州一宗谋杀案的陪审团已选定，全部由白人组成。此案涉及黑人卡梅洛·安东尼被控在达拉斯一个富裕郊区的田径比赛后刺死白人奥斯汀·梅特卡夫。

body.en: Karmelo Anthony, who is Black, is accused of stabbing Austin Metcalf, who was white, at track meet in an affluent Dallas suburb Sign up for the Breaking News US newsletter email After a 2025 high school track meet in Frisco, Texas , ended with one student dead and another accused of murder, Karmelo Anthony, then 17, was indicted on first-degree murder in the fatal stabbing of Austin Metcalf, 17. Social media posts about the death divided the case into racial lines, sparking national outrage. Anthony, who is being tried as an adult, is Black; Metcalf was white. This week marked the beginning of Anthony’s murder trial. Continue reading...
body.zh: 黑人卡梅洛·安东尼被指控在达拉斯富裕郊区的田径比赛中刺伤白人奥斯汀·梅特卡夫 订阅《突发新闻》美国时事通讯电子邮件 2025 年在德克萨斯州弗里斯科举行的一场高中田径运动会以一名学生死亡和另一名学生被指控谋杀而告终，当时 17 岁的卡梅洛·安东尼在刺伤 17 岁奥斯汀·梅特卡夫的致命事件中被指控犯有一级谋杀罪。这起死亡事件将案件分为种族分歧，引发了全国性的愤怒。安东尼作为一名成年人接受审判，他是黑人；梅特卡夫是白人。本周标志着安东尼谋杀案审判的开始。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The selection of an all-white jury in a racially sensitive murder trial raises profound questions about fairness and impartiality within the justice system. When the very process designed to deliver justice appears to be compromised, it can lead to a deep lament for the integrity of the law. This situation reminds us to pray for true justice to prevail,...
reflection.zh: 在一宗涉及种族敏感的谋杀案中，全白人陪审团的选定引发了对司法系统公平性和公正性的深刻质疑。当旨在伸张正义的程序本身似乎受到损害时，这可能导致人们对法律的完整性深感悲叹。这种情况提醒我们为真正的正义能够伸张而祷告，确保所有当事方，无论其背景如何，都能获得公正的审判。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: ‘Immediate national priority’: ministers accused of complacency over UK food supply
title.zh: “当务之急”：大臣们被指对英国粮食供应自满

summary.en: A cold storage and logistics body has warned that the UK's food supplies are at risk from fuel shortages, cyber attacks, and extreme weather, accusing ministers of complacency regarding these vital concerns.
summary.zh: 一个冷藏和物流机构警告称，英国的粮食供应面临燃料短缺、网络攻击和极端天气等风险，并指责政府部长们对这些重要问题表现出自满。

body.en: Cold storage and logistics body warns food supplies at risk from fuel shortages, cyber attacks and extreme weather Ministers have been accused of being complacent about the risks to vital supplies of food into the UK amid concerns over fuel shortages, cyber attacks and extreme weather. The trade body for cold storage and logistics has urged the government to make potential disruption to the UK’s food system an “immediate national priority”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 冷藏和物流机构警告食品供应面临燃料短缺、网络攻击和极端天气的风险 出于对燃料短缺、网络攻击和极端天气的担忧，英国部长们被指责对英国重要食品供应面临的风险沾沾自喜。冷藏和物流贸易机构敦促政府将对英国食品系统的潜在破坏作为“国家当务之急”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The warning about the UK's food supply highlights the importance of foresight and preparedness in leadership. Proverbs reminds us that the prudent see danger and take steps to avoid it, while the simple press on and suffer the consequences. When leaders are complacent about potential risks, the well-being of the people can be jeopardized.
reflection.zh: 关于英国粮食供应的警告，突显了领导层远见和准备的重要性。箴言提醒我们，通达人预见灾祸就藏身，愚蒙人却往前行，而自取祸患。当领导者对潜在风险表现出自满时，人民的福祉可能会受到威胁。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Grave in Norfolk of 119 sailors may be exhumed due to coastal erosion threat
title.zh: 诺福克郡119名水手墓穴或因海岸侵蚀威胁被挖掘

summary.en: A mass grave containing the remains of 119 sailors who drowned in 1801 when HMS Invincible sank off Happisburgh, Norfolk, may need to be exhumed. Coastal erosion threatens to expose the burial site, prompting discussions about preserving the historical remains.
summary.zh: 诺福克郡哈皮斯堡附近，一处埋葬着119名水手的集体墓穴可能因海岸侵蚀而面临挖掘。这些水手于1801年“无敌号”军舰沉没时溺亡，现在他们的遗骸面临被海水冲刷的风险。

body.en: Bodies were buried in Happisburgh after HMS Invincible sank in 1801 on way to join Nelson at Battle of Copenhagen A mass grave for 119 sailors who drowned more than 200 years ago could be exhumed to avoid their remains being exposed by coastal erosion. HMS Invincible sank off the Norfolk coast in 1801 on its way to join Horatio Nelson’s fleet at the Battle of Copenhagen . The recovered bodies of those who drowned were buried at St Mary’s church in Happisburgh, the nearest village to the shipwreck. Continue reading...
body.zh: 1801 年，英国皇家海军无敌号在前往哥本哈根战役与纳尔逊会合的途中沉没，尸体被埋在哈皮斯堡。 200 多年前溺水的 119 名水手的乱葬坑可以被挖掘出来，以避免他们的遗体因海岸侵蚀而暴露。 1801 年，英国皇家海军无敌号在前往参加哥本哈根战役的霍雷肖·纳尔逊舰队的途中在诺福克海岸沉没。打捞上来的溺水者尸体被埋葬在距离沉船最近的村庄哈皮斯堡的圣玛丽教堂。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The potential exhumation of these 18th-century sailors' remains reminds us of the universal appointment of death for all humanity. While nature's forces may disturb their resting place, the story underscores the enduring human desire to honor the deceased and their memory. It prompts us to reflect on our own mortality and the respect owed to every life.
reflection.zh: 这些18世纪水手遗骸可能被挖掘，提醒我们死亡是人类共同的归宿。尽管自然力量可能扰动他们的安息之地，这个故事仍凸显了人类尊重逝者及其记忆的持久愿望。它促使我们反思自身的有限生命，以及对每一条生命的敬重。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

body.en: Kristen Gonzalez, a state senator who authored the bill, said moratorium would target ‘hyperscale’ datacenters over 20MW New York moved closer toward becoming the first US state to enact a moratorium on large datacenters this week. On Thursday, the state legislature approved a one-year ban on the facilities powering the AI boom. The measure now heads to Kathy Hochul, the governor, who will decide whether to sign it into law. The Guardian spoke to a state senator in the wake of the historic vote about authoring the bill and the wider US backlash against datacenters. Continue reading...

title.en: Iran says staff blocked from entering US after players given World Cup visas
title.zh: 伊朗称球员获得世界杯签证后工作人员被禁止进入美国

summary.en: Iranian officials say technical staff have been denied visas, hours after the US said players could enter the country.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Iran has accused the US of denying visas to "integral" members of its national football team's backroom staff, hours after Washington confirmed Iranian players had been given permission to travel to the upcoming World Cup.

US officials said visas had been issued to players and "necessary support staff" on Friday, 10 days before Iran's opening fixture in Los Angeles on 15 June.

It also said Iran would not be allowed to "abuse this system to sneak terrorists into the United States under false pretences".

Iran's embassy in Turkey accused the US of "politically biased interference in sport" by denying further visas to a "large portion of the managerial and executive staff" and "technical advisers".

A statement described the US announcement as a "whitewash", adding: "You have now escalated the deliberate and discriminatory treatment against Iran's national football team to its highest level."

Iranian embassy officials called on Fifa, football's world governing body, to intervene.

Iranian state-linked media said the head of the football federation and his deputy were among those were denied entry to the US.

The 2026 World Cup, which will be jointly hosted by the US, Canada and Mexico, begins on 11 June, with Iran securing their place by finishing top of their qualification group in March 2025, almost a year before war broke out.

It will be the first iteration of the competition to see a host nation receive the team of a country it is at war with.

Earlier this week, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio told lawmakers Iran's football delegation would not be allowed to include individuals linked to the Islamic Revolutionary Guards - a powerful branch of the Iranian armed forces.

Several players in the Iranian squad have completed mandatory military service with the group.

Iran are also due to play Belgium in California and Egypt in Seattle in their other two group games.
body.zh: 伊朗指责美国拒绝向其国家足球队幕后工作人员的“主要”成员发放签证，而就在华盛顿证实伊朗球员已获准前往参加即将举行的世界杯几小时后。 美国官员表示，签证已于周五向球员和“必要的支持人员”发放，距离伊朗队 6 月 15 日在洛杉矶举行的首场比赛还有 10 天。 它还表示，不会允许伊朗“滥用该系统以虚假借口将恐怖分子偷偷进入美国”。 伊朗驻土耳其大使馆指责美国拒绝向“大部分管理和行政人员”以及“技术顾问”发放进一步签证，这是“对体育运动的政治偏见干预”。 一份声明将美国的声明描述为“粉饰”，并补充道：“你们现在将针对伊朗国家足球队的蓄意和歧视性待遇升级到了最高水平。” 伊朗大使馆官员呼吁世界足球管理机构国际足联进行干预。 伊朗官方媒体称，被拒绝入境美国的人包括足协主席及其副手。 2026 年世界杯将由美国、加拿大和墨西哥联合主办，将于 6 月 11 日开幕，伊朗队在 2025 年 3 月（即战争爆发前近一年）以预选赛小组第一的成绩锁定参赛资格。 这将是东道国首次接待交战国球队的比赛。 本周早些时候，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥告诉立法者，伊朗足球代表团将不被允许包括与伊斯兰革命卫队有关的个人，伊斯兰革命卫队是伊朗武装部队的一个强大分支。 伊朗队的几名球员已经完成了义务兵役。 在另外两场小组赛中，伊朗队还将在加利福尼亚州对阵比利时队，在西雅图队对阵埃及队。

title.en: Ukrainian drones target St Petersburg in attack Russia calls 'unprecedented'
title.zh: 乌克兰无人机袭击圣彼得堡，俄罗斯称其“前所未有”

summary.en: Ukrainian drones targeted St Petersburg in an attack described by Russia as 'unprecedented'. The regional governor advised residents to stay indoors, marking the first such directive since the war began.
summary.zh: 乌克兰无人机袭击圣彼得堡，俄罗斯称此次袭击“前所未有”。地区州长首次敦促居民留在家中，这是自战争开始以来的首次。

body.en:
Russian authorities say Ukraine has launched an "unprecedented attack" on and around St Petersburg, as the city hosts the final day of Russia's annual economic forum.

More than 140 drones were shot down over the surrounding Leningrad region, governor Aleksandr Drozdenko said, while the city's governor, Alexander Beglov, urged residents to remain indoors for the first time since the war began.

Ukraine's president said his forces hit Russia's arsenals and a naval base in what he called a just response to Russian attacks.

It comes a day after Vladimir Putin told the forum there was no point in meeting Volodymyr Zelensky, who had called for direct talks on ending the war.

Zelesnky posted on social media on Saturday to say it was "time to end this war", but accused Russia's leader of wanting to "keep fighting".

He said his country's drones had covered a distance of 1,000km (620 miles) to the St Petersburg region, targeting "the enemy navy's arsenals and a base in Kronstadt", referring to the main outpost of the Russian Navy's Baltic Fleet.

Drozdenko said Ukraine's attacks caused a fire at an unspecified military facility, and that residents were being evacuated. He also said buildings sustained "insignificant" damage.

According to Zelensky, an oil depot 500km (310 miles) away, in the southern Krasnodar region, was also hit as part of Ukraine's "long-range sanctions" - a euphemism for strikes on Russia.

These latest attacks follow Ukrainian strikes on the outskirts of St Petersburg as Putin's flagship economic forum was getting under way just days earlier.

The major forum, designed to attract foreign investment into the country, drew thousands of guests from 130 countries, including a low-key US delegation.

On Thursday, Zelensky called for a ceasefire and face-to-face negotiations with Putin to end the war, which began with Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022.

He wrote in an open letter that it would be "wrong to simply wait" for the conflict to once again come to the attention of the US.

Speaking at the economic forum on Friday, Putin refused the request for a meeting and reiterated his position that a truce would only allow Ukraine to regroup.

Russia's longstanding position is that Ukraine should withdraw from the Donetsk, Luhansk, Kherson and Zaporizhzhia regions, as well as abandon efforts to join Nato.

Ukraine has refused to give up any territory, arguing that concessions to Moscow would embolden it to invade again in the future.

Meanwhile, in the Russian-occupied Luhansk region of eastern Ukraine, the Moscow-installed authorities have suspended coach services on two motorways following a campaign of Ukrainian drone strikes targeting Russian logistics.

body.zh: 俄罗斯当局表示，乌克兰在圣彼得堡及其周边地区发动了“史无前例的袭击”，该市正在举办俄罗斯年度经济论坛的最后一天。 州长亚历山大·德罗兹登科 (Aleksandr Drozdenko) 表示，列宁格勒周边地区有 140 多架无人机被击落，而该市州长亚历山大·贝格洛夫 (Alexander Beglov) 则自战争开始以来首次敦促居民留在室内。 乌克兰总统表示，他的军队袭击了俄罗斯的军火库和一个海军基地，他称这是对俄罗斯袭击的公正回应。 就在一天前，俄罗斯总统在论坛上发表讲话，他在讲话中表示，与泽连斯基会面没有任何意义，泽连斯基呼吁就结束战争进行直接谈判。 乌克兰总统泽列斯尼基周六在社交媒体上发帖表示，现在是“结束这场战争的时候了”，但指责普京想要“继续战斗”。 他说，该国的无人机已飞抵圣彼得堡地区1,000公里（620英里），瞄准“敌方海军军火库和喀琅施塔得基地”。 他补充说，500 公里（310 英里）外的俄罗斯南部克拉斯诺达尔地区的一个油库也遭到袭击。 在此之前，泽连斯基周四发出了一封公开信，呼吁与弗拉基米尔·普京进行面对面谈判，以结束战争，这场战争始于俄罗斯 2022 年的全面入侵。 他写道，仅仅等待冲突再次引起美国的关注是“错误的”。 周五，普京拒绝了会面请求，重申了他的立场，即和平谈判应先于停火。 俄罗斯的长期立场是乌克兰应该从顿涅茨克、卢甘斯克、赫尔松和扎波罗热地区撤军，并放弃加入北约的努力。 与此同时，在乌克兰东部被俄罗斯占领的卢甘斯克地区，在乌克兰无人机针对俄罗斯后勤系统发动袭击后，莫斯科当局暂停了两条高速公路上的长途客车服务。 俄罗斯支持的政府还禁止卢甘斯克境内的通勤列车服务和儿童群体的运输。 普京曾表示，俄罗斯完全控制了所谓的“卢甘斯克人民共和国”。 最近几周，乌克兰的无人机部队一直瞄准乌克兰被占领地区的俄罗斯后勤设施。 一位分析师告诉 BBC，自 5 月初以来，已有 200 多辆卡车和 30 多辆加油车遭到袭击。

title.en: Lebanon says three soldiers killed in Israeli attack on car
title.zh: 黎巴嫩称三名士兵在以色列袭击汽车中丧生

summary.en: The Israeli military is investigating the incident in south Lebanon, where it is fighting Hezbollah.

body.en:
The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) says it has launched an investigation after confirming it attacked a vehicle carrying Lebanese soldiers in southern Lebanon on Saturday morning.

The Lebanese Army said two officers and a soldier were killed in the strike on a car, which it described as an "aggressive and barbaric raid". The IDF said the vehicle was "moving suspiciously towards forces" and gunfire had been reported in the area.

Israel has been fighting Lebanon-based Hezbollah since March, primarily in southern Lebanon, from where the armed group has launched rocket and drone attacks.

It is not in direct conflict with the Lebanese government, which is opposed to Hezbollah and has sought to secure a ceasefire.

The strike happened on a road close to the village of Kfar Tebnit, around four miles north of the Litani River and close to the city of Nabatieh, an area which has seen intense fighting and displacement in recent months.

The Israeli military has previously issued sweeping evacuation orders for the region as its forces continue to push north, supported by regular air strikes against Hezbollah targets.

The IDF said the vehicle it struck on Saturday was travelling in an "active and evacuated combat zone" where it believes Hezbollah has operated from.

A statement said troop movements in the area require coordination with the IDF, and repeated that its forces "are operating against the Hezbollah terrorist organisation, not against the Lebanese Army".

It said its initial investigation confirmed three soldiers were believed to be in the vehicle.

The Lebanese Army has reacted furiously to the attack, accusing Israel of "brutal, deliberate and repeated aggression".

It shared images of the burnt out wreckage of a car on a road outside the village.

News of the attack comes after Hezbollah's leadership rejected efforts to revive a US-backed ceasefire agreed between Israel and Lebanon following talks which did not involve the Iran-backed group.

That agreement stipulated Israel would not attack Hezbollah positions in the capital Beirut if the group did not attack Israel, as well as making provisions for "pilot" security zones inside southern Lebanon from which the group would be banned from operating.

Hezbollah's leader Naim Qassem rejected the deal , calling talks between Lebanon and Israel "futile".

Lebanon's government is opposed to Hezbollah but wants to end the fighting on its territory, which has previously involved major air strikes on its capital city.

It has said a ceasefire is necessary in order for its forces to disarm Hezbollah themselves, but Israel has previously accused the government in Beirut of lacking the ability to do so.

body.zh: 以色列国防军（IDF）表示，周六上午在黎巴嫩南部袭击了一辆载有黎巴嫩士兵的车辆后，已展开调查。 黎巴嫩陆军表示，两名军官和一名士兵在对一辆汽车的袭击中丧生，称这是一次“侵略性和野蛮的袭击”。以色列国防军表示，这辆车“可疑地驶向部队”，据报道该地区发生了枪击事件。 自三月以来，以色列一直在与黎巴嫩真主党作战，主要是在黎巴嫩南部，该武装组织从那里发射了火箭弹和无人机袭击。 它与反对真主党并寻求停火的黎巴嫩政府没有直接冲突。 袭击发生在靠近 Kfar Tebnit 村的一条道路上，位于利塔尼河以北约 4 英里处，靠近 Nabatieh 市，该地区近几个月来发生了激烈的战斗和流离失所。 以色列军方此前已对该地区发出全面撤离命令，其部队继续向北推进，并定期对真主党目标进行空袭。 以色列国防军表示，周六被击中的车辆当时正在“活跃且疏散的战区”行驶，以色列国防军相信真主党就是从那里开展行动的。 一份声明称，该地区的部队行动需要与以色列国防军协调，并重申其部队“是针对真主党恐怖组织，而不是针对黎巴嫩军队”。 该公司表示，初步调查证实车内据信有三名士兵。 黎巴嫩军队对这次袭击做出了强烈反应，指责以色列“残酷、蓄意和反复侵略”。 它分享了村外道路上一辆汽车烧毁残骸的图像。 此次袭击的消息传出之前，真主党领导层拒绝了恢复以色列和黎巴嫩之间达成的美国支持的停火协议的努力，此前该协议并未涉及伊朗支持的组织。 该协议规定，如果真主党不攻击以色列，以色列就不会攻击真主党在首都贝鲁特的阵地，并就黎巴嫩南部境内的“试点”安全区做出了规定，禁止该组织在该地区开展活动。 真主党领导人纳伊姆·卡西姆拒绝了该协议，称黎巴嫩和以色列之间的谈判“徒劳”。 黎巴嫩政府反对真主党，但希望结束其领土上的战斗，此前该国首都曾遭受过大规模空袭。 以色列曾表示，为了让其部队解除真主党的武装，必须停火，但以色列此前曾指责贝鲁特政府缺乏这样做的能力。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普寻求化解黎巴嫩冲突，以便与...达成协议

title.en: Public health agency concnered latest Ebola outbreak could become largest on record
title.zh: 公共卫生机构担心最新的埃博拉疫情可能成为有记录以来最大规模的疫情

summary.en: The World Health Organisation says the outbreak is 'moving fast'.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Nearly 500 Ebola cases have now been confirmed in the deadly outbreak raging in central Africa, a WHO overview showed Saturday, amid mounting concern over the swelling scale of the epidemic.

In its daily update on the situation, the World Health Organization tallied 452 confirmed cases, including 82 deaths, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak was declared three weeks ago.

In neighbouring Uganda, meanwhile, it counted 19 confirmed cases, including two deaths.

The total of 471 cases and 84 deaths, based on numbers reported by the DRC and Ugandan governments, marked a hike of 100 cases and 20 deaths from a day earlier.

The increase came amid warnings that the outbreak, which the WHO has declared an international public health emergency, could eventually swell to become the largest on record.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

A top official at the US Centres for Disease Control and Prevention said Friday that models indicated that without strong public health interventions, the current outbreak risked rivalling the scale of the 2014 West Africa epidemic, which saw over 28,000 cases and more than 11,000 deaths.

"That scale is possible," said Jason Asher, director of CDC's Center for Forecasting and Outbreak Analytics, during a press briefing.

Ebola, which is spread through close contact and bodily fluids, has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past 50 years.

The current outbreak was declared on May 15 in northeastern DR Congo, but the virus is believed to have spread under the radar for some time beforehand.

There are no approved vaccines or treatments for the rare Bundibugyo species of Ebola behind the outbreak.

The WHO and the African CDC on Friday launched a $518-million plan to battle the outbreak over the next six months, focusing among other things on boosting surveillance, laboratory testing and infection prevention.

"The outbreak is moving fast, and we are still playing catch-up," WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus told reporters.

"We need to stop the outbreak where it is, support countries that are responding today, and ensure that neighbouring countries are ready to detect and act quickly if cases appear," he said.

"This is a serious outbreak and its one we know how to stop but we need to move fast and together."

title.en: Man dies after bitten by shark in Western Australia, police say
title.zh: 警方称，西澳大利亚男子被鲨鱼咬伤后死亡

summary.en: The man was spearfishing off Michaelmas Island with his family, according to local reports.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A male diver has died after being bitten by a suspected 4.5m (14.8ft) shark in Western Australia, according to local authorities.

The 35-year-old, who has not been named, was spearfishing with family off Michaelmas Island, south-east of Perth, when he was attacked at 11:25 local time (03:25 GMT) on Saturday, police said.

He was taken by boat to shore where he was met by paramedics, who were unable to revive him.

Police said they would prepare a report for the coroner, in a statement shared by local media.

The Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development (DPIRD) said it was assisting police and local authorities with the incident.

It comes less than a month after a father-of-two died after a separate shark attack in Western Australia.

Steven Mattaboni, 38, was attacked by a 4m (13ft) shark at Horseshoe Reef, north-west of the popular Rottnest Island near Perth.

Shark attacks around Australia are more common than in many other parts of the world, though they are often not fatal.

Popular swimming and surfing spots tend to have measures to protect against attacks.
body.zh: 据地方当局称，一名男性潜水员在西澳大利亚被疑似 4.5m（14.8 英尺）长的鲨鱼咬伤后死亡。 警方称，这名未透露姓名的 35 岁男子于周六当地时间 11 点 25 分（格林威治标准时间 03 点 25 分）与家人在珀斯东南部的米迦勒马斯岛附近进行鱼叉捕鱼时遭到袭击。 他被乘船带到岸边，医护人员救治了他，但无法使他苏醒。 当地媒体分享的一份声明中，警方表示他们将为验尸官准备一份报告。 第一产业和地区发展部（DPIRD）表示正在协助警方和地方当局处理这起事件。 不到一个月前，一名两个孩子的父亲在西澳大利亚州发生另一起鲨鱼袭击事件后死亡。 38 岁的史蒂文·马塔博尼 (Steven Mattaboni) 在珀斯 (Perth) 附近热门罗特尼斯岛 (Rottnest Island) 西北部的马蹄礁 (Horseshoe Reef) 遭到一条 4 米（13 英尺）长的鲨鱼袭击。 澳大利亚周围的鲨鱼袭击事件比世界其他许多地区更为常见，尽管它们通常并不致命。 受欢迎的游泳和冲浪地点往往都有防止袭击的措施。

title.en: How the murder of a British teen became an international flashpoint
title.zh: 英国少年谋杀案如何演变为国际焦点

summary.en: Despite an appeal from Henry Nowak's family, right-wing politicians including Pauline Hanson and JD Vance have seized on the case.

body.en:
The murder of British teenager Henry Nowak has become a lightning rod for right-wing debate, with politicians in Australia, the US and UK using it to advance narratives about immigration, race and claims of a "two-tier" policing system .

Among them are One Nation leader Pauline Hanson and US vice president JD Vance, who both spoke out about the case on Friday, with Hanson characterising it as an example of "racism towards white people".

Their comments came despite an appeal from Nowak's father this week that his son's death not be used to create further division, and data that discredits the notion that police treat white people more harshly than other ethnic groups in the UK.

What happened to Nowak, and why has his murder become the focus of a debate stretching far beyond the UK?

The 18-year-old, who was white, was a first year finance and accounting university student in the southern English city of Southampton.

He encountered Vickrum Digwa, 23, while walking home on 3 December after a night out with friends.

Digwa, a British Sikh, was carrying two knives, which he has said he was permitted to carry under exemptions for Sikhs to carry ceremonial daggers.

A UK court heard that Nowak appeared to notice the larger of the two blades and began filming Digwa on his phone.

The judge overseeing the case, William Mousley, said Nowak asked Digwa if he was a "bad man", before Digwa took the phone from him.

When police arrived, Digwa repeated the lie, claiming he had been racially abused.

Police body camera footage shows that officers arrested and handcuffed Nowak, who could be heard saying he had been stabbed and could not breathe.

The court heard Nowak's wounds caused catastrophic internal bleeding and faster medical intervention could not have saved his life.

On Monday, Digwa was sentenced to life in prison with a minimum of 21 years for the murder.

The release of police bodycam footage was shared widely and sparked furious reaction.

The case has become highly politicised, spurring domestic debates about race and policing.

A protest this week in Southampton was attended by prominent right-wing agitators including anti-immigration activist Tommy Robinson, and ended in violent clashes in which attendees threw bricks and bins at police.

Debates over race and immigration have become increasingly divisive in British politics over the past decade, intensifying around the Brexit referendum and remaining highly charged today.

title.en: Tributes to Buffy and Ted Lasso star Anthony Head after death aged 72
title.zh: 《吸血鬼猎人巴菲》和《足球教练》主演安东尼·海德去世，享年72岁，各界致敬

summary.en: The British actor, who also appeared in Merlin and Little Britain, died of complications from pneumonia.
summary.zh: 这位英国演员曾出演《梅林传奇》和《小不列颠》，因肺炎并发症去世。

body.en:
British actor Anthony Head, best known for his roles in TV shows including Buffy the Vampire Slayer, Ted Lasso, Merlin and Little Britain, has died at the age of 72.

Head found international fame as Rupert Giles in hit supernatural teen show Buffy in the late 1990s.

"He passed away peacefully of complications due to pneumonia, surrounded by his family," his daughters Emily and Daisy said.

Sarah Michelle Gellar, who played the eponymous Buffy, led tributes to Head, writing: "Thank you to Daisy and Emily who not only shared their dad with me, but with the world."

His daughters' statement said "it is with heavy hearts that we announce the death of our extraordinary father".

"It has been, and forever will be, an honour and a privilege to be his daughters, and to have witnessed firsthand the impact both he and his work have had on so many."

They also said they knew "how dearly he will be missed by friends, colleagues and fans of the show he was in", adding that he "loved his job very much" and "always considered himself incredibly lucky".

His family acknowledged that "his legacy will live on" and said they considered themselves "lucky" to have watched him doing what he loved throughout his career.

Gellar posted a selection of pictures of her with Head on Instagram, including a scene from Buffy where her character asks Giles whether life gets any easier.

"'Tell Giles I figured it out and I'm ok'. Well, I don't have it figured out and I'm not ok. But I know I'm the lucky one because I knew you," she wrote.

"Thank you to Daisy and Emily who not only shared their dad with me, but with the world."

David Boreanaz, who also starred alongside Head in Buffy, said: "RIP. He was so kind and generous of a soul."

Fellow Buffy co-star James Marsters said: "He was an unflaggingly kind and steady presence on the set of Buffy, and the best actor in the cast... I was lucky to have known, and learned from him."

Following Buffy, Head went on to have a recurring role in sketch show Little Britain as the prime minister and king Uther Pendragon in the BBC's Merlin.

Little Britain creator and star Matt Lucas - in which Head played the prime minister - described Head as "unfailingly brilliant, and always so kind and warm".

"When we were casting Little Britain, we were looking for a 'Tony Head-type ', because we never imagined for a moment that the man himself would be interested, but he was. Lucky us," Lucas said.

Head's other credits included playing Geoffrey Howe in The Iron Lady and appearing in Doctor Who, Persuasion, The Inbetweeners and Manchild.

He also starred in Ted Lasso from 2020 as former Richmond FC owner Rupert Mannion, the ex-husband of Hannah Waddingham's character Rebecca Welton.

Brett Goldstein, their co-star and a writer on the show, said:...
body.zh: 英国演员安东尼·海德因出演《吸血鬼猎人巴菲》、《泰德·拉索》、《梅林传奇》和《小不列颠》等电视剧而闻名，现已去世，享年 72 岁。 海德因在 20 世纪 90 年代末热播的超自然青少年电视剧《巴菲》中饰演鲁珀特·吉尔斯而享誉国际。 他的女儿艾米丽和黛西说：“他因肺炎并发症在家人的陪伴下平静地去世。” 饰演同名巴菲的莎拉·米歇尔·盖拉 (Sarah Michelle Gellar) 向海德致敬，她写道：“感谢黛西和艾米丽，她们不仅与我分享了他们的父亲，还与全世界分享了他们的父亲。” 他女儿们的声明称，“我们怀着沉重的心情宣布我们非凡的父亲去世”。 “成为他的女儿，并亲眼目睹他和他的工作对这么多人产生的影响，一直是、也将永远是一种荣幸。” 他们还表示，他们知道“他所参加的节目的朋友、同事和粉丝将会多么想念他”，并补充说他“非常热爱自己的工作”并且“一直认为自己非常幸运”。 他的家人承认“他的遗产将继续存在”，并表示他们认为自己“幸运”能够看到他在整个职业生涯中做他喜欢的事情。 盖拉在 Instagram 上发布了一系列她和 Head 的照片，其中包括《巴菲》中的一个场景，其中她扮演的角色问吉尔斯，生活是否变得更轻松了。 “‘告诉吉尔斯我想通了，我就没事了’。好吧，我还没想通，我就不好了。但我知道我是幸运的，因为我认识你，”她写道。 “感谢黛西和艾米丽，她们不仅与我分享了她们的父亲，还与全世界分享了她们的父亲。” 与海德一起主演《巴菲》的大卫·伯伦纳兹 (David Boreanaz) 表示：“安息吧。他是如此善良和慷慨。” 《巴菲》的联合主演詹姆斯·马斯特斯表示：“他在《巴菲》的片场中始终保持着善良和稳定的形象，也是演员阵容中最好的演员……我很幸运能够认识他，并向他学习。” 继《巴菲》之后，海德继续在小品秀《小不列颠》中反复扮演首相，并在 BBC 电视剧《梅林传奇》中饰演国王乌瑟·潘德拉贡。 《小不列颠》的创作者兼明星马特·卢卡斯（海德在剧中饰演首相）形容海德“始终才华横溢，而且总是那么善良和热情”。 “当我们选角《小不列颠》时，我们正在寻找‘托尼·海德型’，因为我们从来没想过这个人本人会感兴趣，但他确实感兴趣。我们很幸运，”卢卡斯说。 海德的其他作品包括在《铁娘子》中扮演杰弗里·豪，并出现在《神秘博士》、《劝说》、《中间人》和《Manchild》中。 他还在 2020 年主演的《泰德·拉索》中饰演里士满足球俱乐部前老板鲁珀特·曼尼恩，他是汉娜·沃丁汉姆扮演的角色丽贝卡·韦尔顿的前夫。 他们的搭档兼剧作家布雷特·戈德斯坦 (Brett Goldstein) 说：...

reflection.en: The passing of Anthony Head at 72 reminds us of the precious, finite nature of life and the impact we can have in the time we are given. As we reflect on a life well-lived, we are invited to consider how we might number our own days with wisdom and purpose. May we seek to live each day in a way that honors the gift of life.
reflection.zh: 安东尼·海德享年72岁去世，这提醒我们生命的宝贵和有限，以及我们在有生之年所能产生的影响。当我们回顾他精彩的一生时，我们也被邀请思考如何智慧而有目标地度过自己的每一天。愿我们努力活出每一天，以尊荣生命的恩赐。

verse.textEn: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verse.textZh: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。

title.en: Fujimori or Sanchez? Peru vote marks 10 years of turmoil
title.zh: 秘鲁选举标志着十年动荡

summary.en: Sunday's presidential runoff in Peru pits Keiko Fujimori against Roberto Sanchez in an election marked by social tension, rising crime and declining confidence in political institutions.
summary.zh: 秘鲁周日的总统决选在藤森惠子和罗伯托·桑切斯之间展开，此次选举的特点是社会紧张、犯罪率上升以及民众对政治机构的信心下降。

body.en:
Sunday's presidential runoff in Peru pits Keiko Fujimori against Roberto Sanchez in an election marked by social tension, rising crime and declining confidence in political institutions.

Nine presidents in 10 years — the figure speaks volumes about the current state of Peruvian politics.

On Sunday, voters will return to the polls. This time, they will choose between Keiko Fujimori , leader of the conservative Popular Force party, and Roberto Sanchez, the candidate for the left-wing Together for Peru. Whoever prevails at the ballot, Peruvians will vote in a climate of deep distrust of institutions, political fragmentation and growing concern over insecurity.

For many observers, the central question is not only who will win the presidency, but whether Peru will be able to break out of the cycle of political crises that has characterized its past decade.

The first round revealed the weakness of Peru's political system. Keiko Fujimori advanced to the runoff with just 17% of the vote, while Roberto Sanchez secured around 12%, highlighting a fragmented political landscape in which 35 presidential candidates competed. The result illustrates the extent to which both finalists lack broad support and enter the second round amid a profound crisis of representation.

For Alonso Cardenas, a political science professor at Antonio Ruiz de Montoya University, the roots of the problem run deeper than a simple electoral contest.

"There is widespread discrediting of the ruling class," Cardenas told DW. According to the political scientist, the widespread public rejection extends to Congress, the presidency and the judiciary. "It is a very serious process of implosion within the system of political representation."

Johanna Pieper, a researcher at the German Institute for Global and Area Studies, agrees that the election reflects a long-running crisis. "People are simply not happy or satisfied. They have no confidence in politics, the government, or Congress," Pieper told DW. She also points to a society divided between Lima and historically marginalized regions, particularly the Andean highlands.

Keiko Fujimori once again places the country's best-known — and most polarizing — political figure at the center of the campaign. She is the daughter of former President Alberto Fujimori , who ruled Peru between 1990 and 2000.

The movement known as Fujimorismo has shaped Peruvian politics for decades. Its supporters point to economic stabilization and the fight against the Maoist guerrilla group Shining Path . Critics, however, highlight deep-seated authoritarian tendencies, corruption scandals and serious human rights violations during her father's time in office.

body.zh: 周日在秘鲁举行的总统决选中，藤森惠子与罗伯托·桑切斯展开了这场选举，这场选举的特点是社会紧张、犯罪率上升和对政治机构的信心下降。 十年内有九位总统——这个数字充分说明了秘鲁政治的现状。 周日，选民将重返投票站。这一次，他们将在保守派人民力量党领袖藤森惠子和左翼秘鲁团结党候选人罗伯托·桑切斯之间做出选择。无论谁在投票中获胜，秘鲁人都将在对机构极度不信任、政治分裂和对不安全问题日益担忧的气氛中投票。 对于许多观察家来说，核心问题不仅在于谁将赢得总统职位，还在于秘鲁是否能够摆脱过去十年的政治危机循环。 第一轮选举暴露了秘鲁政治制度的弱点。藤森惠子 (Keiko Fujimori) 仅以 17% 的得票率晋级决选，而罗伯托·桑切斯 (Roberto Sanchez) 则获得了 12% 左右的选票，凸显了 35 名总统候选人角逐的分散的政治格局。这一结果说明了两位决赛入围者缺乏广泛支持并在深刻的代表性危机中进入第二轮的程度。 对于安东尼奥·鲁伊斯·德蒙托亚大学政治学教授阿隆索·卡德纳斯来说，问题的根源比简单的竞选更为深刻。 卡德纳斯告诉德国之声：“统治阶级的名誉普遍受到损害。”这位政治学家表示，公众的广泛反对延伸到了国会、总统和司法部门。 “这是政治代表制度内一个非常严重的内爆过程。” 德国全球与地区研究所研究员约翰娜·皮珀（Johanna Pieper）也认为这次选举反映了一场长期危机。 “人们根本不高兴或不满意。他们对政治、政府或国会没有信心，”皮珀告诉德国之声。她还指出了利马和历史上边缘化地区（特别是安第斯高地）之间的社会分裂。 藤森庆子再次将日本最著名、也是最两极分化的政治人物置于竞选活动的中心。她是 1990 年至 2000 年间统治秘鲁的前总统阿尔贝托·藤森 (Alberto Fujimori) 的女儿。 几十年来，被称为“藤森主义”的运动塑造了秘鲁的政治。其支持者将矛头指向经济稳定和打击毛派游击队组织“光辉道路”。然而，批评者强调了她父亲任职期间根深蒂固的独裁倾向、腐败丑闻和严重侵犯人权的行为。 政治学家...

reflection.en: A nation grappling with a decade of turmoil, social tension, and declining trust in its institutions highlights the profound impact of governance on societal well-being. This situation reminds us that a nation's health is deeply connected to the moral fabric and integrity of its leadership and systems.
reflection.zh: 一个国家在经历了十年动荡、社会紧张和对机构信任度下降之后，凸显了治理对社会福祉的深远影响。这提醒我们，一个国家的健康状况与其领导层和制度的道德结构和廉正性息息相关。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

title.en: As hot summer, blackouts loom, Iraq looks to solar power
title.zh: 随着酷暑和停电的临近，伊拉克转向太阳能

summary.en: Iraq faces annual summer electricity crises despite abundant sunlight, a natural resource ideal for solar power. The government has only recently begun to seriously consider solar energy as a solution to these persistent blackouts.
summary.zh: 伊拉克每年夏季都面临电力危机，尽管该国拥有充足的阳光，非常适合发展太阳能。然而，伊拉克政府直到最近才开始认真考虑将太阳能作为解决这些长期停电问题的方案。

body.en:
With so much sunlight, Iraq is very well-positioned to use solar power to help fix its annual summer electricity crisis. So why is it that Iraq's government has only recently started to take solar power seriously?

Iraq has long suffered through scorching summers that the country's national grid hasn't been able to keep up with. But it was only recently that Hiba al-Amiri's family started to seriously consider getting solar panels installed at home to compensate for the annual summer blackouts .

"In the war, Iranian gas was cut and for four days, we had no electricity," the Baghdad-based teacher told DW. Iran supplies up to 40% of the gas that Iraq needs to keep its power stations running, In March, Iran completely cut gas to Iraq after Israel attacked its gas fields .

"We were only using the generator," al-Amiri continued. "After that, a lot of our neighbors were also talking about this [solar]. Everybody is really starting to think about it seriously." 

Installing solar panels in a private household costs somewhere between 5 and 10 million Iraqi dinars (around $3,800-$7,600/€3,200-€6,500), experts told DW. Al-Amiri said she and her brother are now saving money toward that goal, and hope to get a unit by next year.

"The thinking is that we will pay for this project [solar panels] in one year but then after that we won't need to pay for the generator power again," she explained.

Even on its best days, the Iraqi national grid only supplies private households between eight and 12 hours of electricity a day. Ordinary Iraqis compensate for the missing power by paying a subscription to local generator operators. Households in a city like Baghdad might pay between $100 (€86) and $300 a month to keep the lights on.

It's not that Iraqis didn't know about solar power, explained Harry Istepanian, an energy expert and founder of the Washington-based think tank, the Iraq Climate Change Center. "But the generator system was familiar, flexible and required no large upfront investment," he said. "Solar, by contrast, requires capital, reliable equipment, batteries, technical installation and after-sales support."

Additionally, as the International Renewable Energy Agency wrote in a 2025 report , energy tariffs in Iraq are heavily subsidized, which also discourages the private sector from investing in renewables.

But now, generator fees are rising and there's no longer enough state-subsidized diesel for generators. "As a result, solar is gaining appeal. Not because Iraqis have suddenly discovered it but because the cost of relying on the old system has become higher," said Istepanian.

body.zh: 伊拉克拥有如此充足的阳光，非常适合利用太阳能来帮助解决每年夏季的电力危机。那么，为什么伊拉克政府最近才开始认真对待太阳能呢？ 伊拉克长期以来一直遭受国家电网无法应对的炎热夏季。但直到最近，希巴·阿米里 (Hiba al-Amiri) 的家人才开始认真考虑在家中安装太阳能电池板，以弥补每年夏季停电的影响。 “在战争中，伊朗的天然气被切断，我们有四天没有电，”巴格达的老师告诉德国之声。 伊朗供应了伊拉克发电站运行所需的高达40%的天然气，3月份，在以色列袭击其气田后，伊朗完全切断了对伊拉克的天然气供应。 “我们只使用发电机，”阿米里继续说道。 “在那之后，我们的很多邻居也开始谈论这个[太阳能]。每个人都开始认真思考它。” 专家告诉德国之声，在私人家庭安装太阳能电池板的成本约为 5 至 1000 万伊拉克第纳尔（约 3,800-7,600 美元/3,200-6,500 欧元）。阿米里说，她和她的兄弟现在正在为这个目标存钱，并希望在明年之前得到一套房子。 “我们的想法是，我们将在一年内支付这个项目（太阳能电池板）的费用，但之后我们将不需要再次支付发电机的费用，”她解释道。 即使在最好的日子里，伊拉克国家电网每天也只能为私人家庭提供 8 至 12 小时的电力。 普通伊拉克人通过向当地发电机运营商付费来弥补电力缺失。像巴格达这样的城市，家庭每月可能需要支付 100 美元（86 欧元）到 300 美元才能维持照明。 能源专家、华盛顿智库伊拉克气候变化中心的创始人哈里·伊斯特潘尼安 (Harry Istepanian) 解释说，伊拉克人并不是不了解太阳能。 “但发电机系统很熟悉、灵活，不需要大量的前期投资，”他说。 “相比之下，太阳能需要资金、可靠的设备、电池、技术安装和售后支持。” 此外，正如国际可再生​​能源机构在2025年报告中所写，伊拉克的能源关税得到了大量补贴，这也阻碍了私营部门对可再生能源的投资。 但现在，发电机费不断上涨，国家补贴的柴油不再足够用于发电机。 “因此，太阳能越来越有吸引力。不是因为伊拉克人突然发现了它，而是因为依赖旧系统的成本变得更高，”伊斯特潘尼安说。 阿玛尼·易卜拉欣 (Amani Ibraheem) 表示，伊拉克拥有世界上最高水平的太阳辐射，这使其成为太阳能的完美候选者......

reflection.en: The story of Iraq's delayed embrace of solar power highlights the critical role of wise counsel and foresight in national governance. When leaders fail to plan effectively or heed sound advice, communities can suffer from persistent, avoidable challenges. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that a nation's stability and well-being depend on good guidance.
reflection.zh: 伊拉克迟迟未能利用太阳能的故事，凸显了国家治理中明智的建议和远见的重要性。当领导者未能有效规划或听取良好建议时，社区可能会遭受持续的、本可避免的挑战。箴言11:14提醒我们，一个国家的稳定和福祉取决于良好的指导。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: US says Iranian coastal radar sites struck after drones threaten shipping
title.zh: 美国称无人机威胁航运后袭击了伊朗沿海雷达站

summary.en: The latest exchange of strikes in the Gulf, involving US action against Iranian coastal radar sites after drones threatened shipping, jeopardizes ongoing efforts to end the three-month war.
summary.zh: 在波斯湾，美国对伊朗沿海雷达站发动袭击，此前有无人机威胁航运。此次最新的交火行动，威胁到旨在结束长达三个月战争的努力。

body.en:
The United States military says it has struck Iranian coastal radar sites after Iran launched drones towards the Strait of Hormuz, in the latest escalation complicating efforts to end the war between the two countries.

A US official told Reuters the military believed the four Iranian drones were targeting regional maritime traffic. The US Central Command said on X that the it then struck Iranian surveillance sites in Goruk and Qeshm Island, which are both on the Strait of Hormuz.

Iran’s Revolutionary Guard Corps said it had targeted US bases in the region with missiles in retaliation for strikes, and fired on four tankers attempting to cross the strait without its permission.

Kuwaiti air defences were intercepting missile and drone attacks of undisclosed origin, state media reported, while in Bahrain, sirens sounded and residents were urged to seek shelter.

Iran said it had hit US bases in both countries with ballistic missiles but the US military said six missiles were intercepted and a seventh did not reach its target.

The US and Iran have been engaged in largely indirect negotiations to secure an interim deal to halt the three-month-old war that would leave issues including Iran's nuclear programme to further negotiations.

As part of any agreement, Iran wants access to billions of dollars in oil revenue, waivers on sanctions on crude exports, the lifting of a US blockade on its ports and leverage over the strait.

Iran has effectively blocked the strait, where about a fifth of the world's oil transited before the war.

US President Donald Trump is facing mounting domestic political pressure due to rising gas prices to bring the unpopular war to an end.

He told NBC that while most of Iran's drone and missile manufacturing facilities had been destroyed, the Iranians still have access to about a fifth of their missiles.

"They have some missiles, they have some drones. I would say percentage wise, maybe 21 per cent, 22 per cent of their missiles. It's a lot of missiles, but it's not what it was when we first attacked," Trump told NBC News' on Friday, local time.

When asked why Iran’s leaders — if as desperate as he has portrayed them — were not more inclined to strike a deal, Trump said: "Because they are strong. They're proud. There are things they never thought they'd be doing that they're going to have to do, they've got no choice, and it takes a little while."

title.en: Putin says 'no point' meeting with Zelenskyy, vowing to double down on war efforts
title.zh: 普京称与泽连斯基会面“毫无意义”，誓言加倍努力进行战争

summary.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin has stated there is "no point" in meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, indicating a commitment to intensify war efforts. Zelenskyy had previously called for a direct meeting to resolve the four-year conflict.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京表示，与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基会面“毫无意义”，并誓言将加倍努力进行战争。泽连斯基此前曾呼吁两位领导人举行直接会谈以结束这场持续四年的战争。

body.en:
Russian President Vladimir Putin has ruled out meeting his Ukrainian counterpart any time soon, a day after Volodymyr Zelenskyy called for a sit-down between the leaders to end the four-year war.

Speaking at an economic forum in his home city of Saint Petersburg, Putin said he saw "no point" in meeting Zelenskyy until a possible peace deal had been agreed.

Putin also vowed to press on with Russia's military offensive until its war goals had been achieved.

Zelenskyy hit back saying the Russian leader was "weak" and "choosing war again".

Russia has demanded control of Ukraine's eastern Donbas region as well as sweeping political and military restrictions on its neighbour.

Ukraine and its allies have ruled the conditions as tantamount to capitulation and US-brokered peace talks have failed to bring the sides closer.

Zelenskyy on Friday, local time, issued a rare direct appeal to the Russian leader.

"Ukraine proposes ending this war through direct engagement between us — and you. I am proposing a meeting," Zelenskyy said in an open letter.

"I see no point in meeting. It only makes sense for the Ukrainian side to stop the advance of our armed forces. That's it. And we need agreements," Putin told Russia's flagship economic forum.

"Let the experts work, develop some solutions, and then we can meet," Putin added.

Hundreds of thousands have been killed since Putin launched his full-scale offensive — which he calls a "special military operation" — in February 2022.

Swathes of eastern and southern Ukraine have been destroyed and millions forced from their homes in the four-year campaign the Kremlin hoped would have toppled the country within a matter of days.

Russia staged new deadly attacks on Thursday, with Ukrainian authorities saying four civilians were killed and seven wounded in Russian strikes on Mykolaivka and Druzhkivka in the Donetsk region.

"Unfortunately, the Russian side is choosing war again — everyone heard today's response. A weak response. He simply doesn't want to end the war," he said after Putin rejected the call.

His proposal had won support from key allies, including US President Donald Trump and French President Emmanuel Macron.

Zelenskyy is to meet Macron, UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and Germany's Chancellor Friedrich Merz in London on Sunday in a bid to inject fresh momentum into diplomatic efforts.

"Military actions will end some day, we assume. Without a doubt, they will end once we have achieved the goals we have set for ourselves," Putin told the audience of business leaders and visiting dignitaries from Russia's allies.

title.en: How disinformation in Congo is worsening Ebola epidemic
title.zh: 刚果的虚假信息如何加剧埃博拉疫情

summary.en: The deadly Ebola outbreak isn't the only thing causing concern for health workers in Congo. Rumors and disinformation are hindering efforts to contain the virus. The patterns are well-known — and could be confronted.
summary.zh: 致命的埃博拉疫情并非刚果卫生工作者唯一担忧的问题。谣言和虚假信息正在阻碍控制病毒的努力。这些模式众所周知，并且可以加以应对。

body.en:
The deadly Ebola outbreak isn't the only thing causing concern for health workers in Congo. Rumors and disinformation are hindering efforts to contain the virus. The patterns are well-known — and could be confronted.

Three weeks since the start of the latest  Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo , there have been 397 confirmed cases, including 63 confirmed deaths, according to the latest figures reported by the  African Union's Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention.

And yet: "The community does not believe in this disease. Despite the deaths, people don't believe in it," said John Tumujimbe, head of a team for dignified and safe burials in the small town of Mongbwalu, one of the epicenters of the Ebola epidemic in the Congo's northeastern Ituri province.

"We initially thought of malaria , typhoid or diarrheal diseases," Tumujimbe said. "But, after so many deaths, we sent samples to the INRB."

The INRB — Congo's National Institute for Biomedical Research in the capital, Kinshasa — confirmed that these were indeed cases of Ebola. This led health officials to announce  the 17th Ebola epidemic to be recorded in Congo since the virus was first discovered in 1976.

But health officials say many residents in Mongbwalu rejected this scientific answer.

"When there were the first deaths, there was talk that the coffins were a problem, that it spread from there," said one Mongbwalu resident, who did not want to be named.

Tumujimbe also heard this rumor. "That's how it started: people talked about a coffin that kills people. And then more people died."

Another rumor: Aid workers and paramedics were spreading the virus via the antennas of their vehicles.

At the end of May, an angry crowd gathered at Mongbwalu's general hospital. They demanded that authorities return the bodies of their deceased, eventually setting fire to a tent belonging to the aid organization Doctors Without Borders. The organization had to withdraw its staff.

"There was a panic," hospital director Richard Lokudi told DW. "This allowed several suspected cases to escape. Eighteen patients who were under observation have disappeared."

The health workers worry suspected Ebola patients could have passed the disease on to the people who were sheltering them. There is still no vaccine for the Bundibugyo variant of the Ebola virus now circulating.

Christopher Nehring specializes in researching disinformation, and co-authored a report on the current Ebola epidemic for the Konrad Adenauer Foundation. He said similar rumors pop up in every health emergency.

title.en: North Korea quietly ramps up its nuclear program
title.zh: 朝鲜悄然加紧核计划

summary.en: North Korea has been quietly advancing its nuclear weapons program while international attention is focused elsewhere. This week, leader Kim Jong Un visited a new nuclear fuel facility and pledged to produce more bombs.

body.en:
With Washington's attention elsewhere, North Korea has slowly been building up its nuclear weapons program. This week, Kim Jong Un took a publicity tour of a new nuclear fuel facility while promising to build more bombs.

On Thursday, North Korean leader Kim Jong Un reminded the world of Pyongyang's nuclear threat, announcing plans to bolster nuclear forces "at an exponential rate," as state media carried footage of Kim visiting what South Korea said was likely a new uranium enrichment plant. 

The plant's unveiling came a week after the North Korean Foreign Ministry issued a statement vowing that the "denuclearization" of North Korea "will never happen."

This was in response to the foreign ministers of the US, Japan, India and Australia, which comprises the so-called Quad grouping , calling for the "complete denuclearization" of North Korea after a meeting in New Delhi.

North Korea has become more defiant in building up its nuclear program, with Kim declaring in February 2026 that North Korea's status as a nuclear state is "completely and absolutely irreversible."

Kim also insisted that any negotiation or diplomatic engagement with the US was contingent on Washington recognizing North Korea as a nuclear-armed state.

North Korea's nuclear program has drawn little attention so far during the second term of US President Donald Trump , who met Kim three times during his first term.

However, Trump's high-profile US-North Korea summits in 2018 and 2019, which focused on getting Kim to abandon his nuclear weapons , went nowhere. Since then, North Korea has been laying the institutional and physical groundwork for a more robust nuclear weapons program.

In 2023, North Korea amended its constitution to enshrine its "nuclear force-building policy."  At the same time, Pyongyang has degraded ties with South Korea, calling it a "hostile state" and dropping any pretense of "reunification."

In early May 2026, South Korean intelligence revealed that Pyongyang had codified an "automatic nuclear launch" policy into law, if the central command-and-control apparatus or Kim himself is targeted by "hostile forces."

In April 2026, US Assistant Secretary of Defense Robert Kadlec told the Senate Armed Services Committee that North Korea's nuclear forces "are increasingly capable of targeting the US," and its missile forces "can strike South Korea and Japan with nuclear or conventional warheads."

"These forces are growing in size and sophistication, and they present a clear and present danger of nuclear attack," Kadlec said.

Yet, the prophetic vision of swords beaten into plowshares offers a powerful counter-narrative, inviting us to hope for a future where ingenuity is turned towards life-giving purposes, not war. This vision calls us to pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 国家扩充军备的消息可能引发深切的忧虑，提醒我们人类制造毁灭的能力。然而，将刀剑打成犁头的先知性异象提供了一个有力的反叙事，邀请我们盼望一个未来，那时人类的智慧将用于造福生命，而非战争。这个异象呼唤我们为领袖和世界祷告，愿和平胜过对毁灭性力量的追求。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Being Towards Death review – Chinese hospital comedy drama uses plucky patients to ask big questions
title.zh: 《向死而生》影评——中国医院喜剧剧情片以坚韧的病人提出重大问题

summary.en: A Chinese hospital comedy-drama explores themes of life and death through a debt-laden caregiver who, after a suicide attempt, finds new meaning from terminally ill patients. A doctor in the film notes, 'Life is a process of constant decay.'
summary.zh: 一部中国医院喜剧剧情片通过一名负债累累的护理人员探讨了生与死的主题，他在一次自杀未遂后，从身患绝症的病人那里找到了生命的全新意义。片中一位医生指出：“生命是一个不断衰败的过程。”

body.en: A debt-laden caregiver attempting suicide is the catalyst for him finding new meaning to life from a ward of terminally ill patients in touching ensemble drama ‘You know the law of entropy? Life is a process of constant decay,” ssays a doctor in this Chinese hospital comedy drama – but not that you’d know it from the gabbling, frenetic first half-hour of director Chen Sicheng’s death-fixated film. Being Towards Death kicks off with caregiver Xiaobing (Jiang Long) about to throw himself off the roof because, after a scheme to flog his superiors care robots fails, he’s in hock to triad loan sharks. Thankfully the film later settles into an intermittently touching ensemble drama with a meta tint; albeit one that doesn’t fully grasp the profundities it’s aiming for. Hauled back from the ledge, Xiaobing is talked by the hospital director into leading a project studying mental health interventions in terminal cancer care. So he finds himself among the “Ward 10 Fearless Squad”, a group of patients whose outlook is as plucky as their diagnoses are grim. Before long, he has co-opted film director Dao (Wang Zichuan) to make a documentary about his roomies, including bullish property mogul Mau (Cai Ming), browbeaten first son Bowen (Huang Yi) and fib-spinning poppet, Xiaobing (Ye Quanxi) – nicknamed Little Bing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在感人的合奏剧《你知道熵定律吗？这部中国医院喜剧片中的一位医生说：“生命是一个不断腐烂的过程。”但你不会从陈思诚导演这部以死亡为主题的电影的前半小时里喋喋不休、疯狂的内容中了解到这一点。《向死而生》以护理人员小冰（姜龙饰）开始，他打算从屋顶上跳下去，因为在鞭打上级护理机器人的计划失败后，他陷入了黑社会高利贷的困境。值得庆幸的是，这部电影后来这部充满元色彩的时断时续、感人至深的合奏剧虽然没有完全领会其目标，但小冰被医院院长说服去领导一个研究癌症晚期护理心理健康干预的项目，因此他发现自己属于“10号病房无畏小队”，这群患者的前景与他们的诊断一样严峻。道（王紫川饰）要制作一部关于他的室友的纪录片，其中包括看涨的地产大亨毛（蔡明饰）、受威吓的长子鲍文（黄毅饰）和爱撒谎的傀儡小兵（外号小兵）继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story beautifully illustrates how, even as our physical bodies face decay, there can be a profound renewal of spirit and purpose. The caregiver's journey, sparked by the resilience of terminally ill patients, reminds us that inner strength can emerge even when outer circumstances are fading.
reflection.zh: 这个故事优美地阐释了，即使我们的肉体面临衰败，精神和生命目的仍能得到深刻的更新。护理人员的旅程，因身患绝症病人的坚韧而受到启发，提醒我们即使外部环境逐渐消逝，内在的力量依然能够涌现。

verse.textEn: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though outwardly we are wasting away, yet inwardly we are being renewed day by day.
verse.textZh: 所以，我们不丧胆。外体虽然毁坏，内心却一天新似一天。

title.en: US journalist pleads guilty to working as China's agent
title.zh: 美国记者承认充当中国代理人

summary.en: Thomas Weir Pauken II, 50, knowingly worked with people employed by the Chinese government for years.
summary.zh: 50岁的托马斯·威尔·保肯二世承认多年来故意与中国政府雇员合作。

body.en:
A US journalist who had been living and working in China for over a decade has pleaded guilty in a US court to working as an illegal agent for the People's Republic of China (PRC).

Thomas Weir Pauken II, 50, "admitted to being part of a conspiracy to obtain sensitive information from the US government" for China, US Assistant Attorney General for National Security John A Eisenberg said.

Court filings show that Pauken had been living in China since 2010 and had worked for several media organisations there, including CCTV and Xinhua News.

Pauken worked "at the direction and control of people he knew worked for the PRC" from at least 2019 until February this year, according to court documents.

Among the people Pauken worked with was a person identified as "Cathy", whom the US Department of Justice (DOJ) said provided him with "taskings, including meeting with potential intelligence assets".

Pauken and "Cathy" were introduced by a man employed as a speechwriter for Chinese President Xi Jinping during the "Trump-China trade wars" in 2017, court filings show.

The DOJ said that the US journalist received at least $100,000 (£73,000) from "Cathy" for his work.

Pauken was also instructed to travel several times between 2019 and 2025 to meet people in the US who could provide him with information to pass on to the PRC.

The American journalist "gathered intelligence on his American targets and reported it back to his Chinese intelligence handlers", said Assistant Director Roman Rozhavsky of the FBI's Counterintelligence and Espionage Division.

Rozhavsky added that the case was an example of "the lengths to which the Chinese Communist Party will go to undermine our democratic institutions and degrade our political freedoms".

Pauken worked with two other people in China, identified as "William" and "Richard", who told the US journalist that reports he filed for them were being sent to Japan.

Pauken also sold a group of people from Wuhan information about the US DOJ and information about technology. They also asked Pauken to support them in finding an expert to help them engage in cyber espionage.

After the hearing in Alexandria, Virginia, Pauken's attorney Charles Burnham gave a statement to Politico that said his client accepted responsibility and was trying to "promote peaceful relations and advance the cause of religious freedom in China".

Pauken is scheduled to be sentenced on 1 September and faces a maximum sentence of 10 years in prison.
body.zh: 一名在中国生活和工作十多年的美国记者在美国法院承认为中华人民共和国（PRC）担任非法代理人。 美国负责国家安全事务的助理司法部长约翰·A·艾森伯格 (John A Eisenberg) 表示，50 岁的托马斯·威尔·保肯二世 (Thomas Weir Pauken II) “承认参与了从美国政府获取敏感信息的阴谋”。 法庭文件显示，保肯自2010年以来一直居住在中国，并曾在包括中央电视台和新华社在内的多家媒体机构工作。 法庭文件显示，至少从 2019 年到今年 2 月，保肯“在他认识的为中华人民共和国工作的人的指导和控制下”工作。 与保肯共事的人中有一个人被称为“凯茜”，美国司法部（DOJ）表示，她为他提供了“任务，包括会见潜在的情报人员”。 法庭文件显示，2017 年“特朗普与中国的贸易战”期间，一名受聘为中国国家主席习近平演讲撰稿人的男子介绍了 Pauken 和“Cathy”。 美国司法部表示，这名美国记者从“凯茜”那里获得了至少 10 万美元（7.3 万英镑）的报酬。 保肯还被指示在 2019 年至 2025 年间多次前往美国会见可以向他提供信息并转交给中国的人士。 联邦调查局反情报和间谍部门助理主任罗曼·罗扎夫斯基 (Roman Rozhavsky) 表示，这名美国记者“收集了有关他的美国目标的情报，并将其报告给中国情报人员”。 罗扎夫斯基补充说，此案是“中国共产党将不遗余力破坏我们的民主制度并降低我们的政治自由”的一个例子。 鲍肯与中国的另外两个人（即“威廉”和“理查德”）一起工作，他们告诉美国记者，他为他们提交的报告将被发送到日本。 保肯还向一群来自武汉的人出售有关美国司法部的信息和有关技术的信息。他们还要求保肯支持他们寻找专家来帮助他们从事网络间谍活动。 在弗吉尼亚州亚历山大举行的听证会结束后，保肯的律师查尔斯·伯纳姆向《政治》杂志发表声明称，他的当事人承担了责任，并试图“促进和平关系，推进中国的宗教自由事业”。 Pauken 定于 9 月 1 日被判刑，最高可判处 10 年监禁。

reflection.en: The news of a journalist pleading guilty to acting as a foreign agent highlights the profound importance of integrity and trustworthiness in all professions. Luke 16:10 reminds us that faithfulness in small matters reflects one's character in larger responsibilities. This incident underscores how a lack of honesty, even in seemingly minor choices, can lead...
reflection.zh: 一名记者承认充当外国代理人的消息，突显了在所有职业中诚信和信任的极端重要性。路加福音16:10提醒我们，在小事上忠心的人，在大事上也忠心。这起事件强调了缺乏诚实，即使是在看似微小的选择中，也可能随着时间的推移导致对信任和忠诚的重大背叛。

verse.textEn: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
verse.textZh: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。

title.en: Xi Jinping to meet Kim Jong Un in rare visit to North Korea
title.zh: 习近平将罕见访问朝鲜会晤金正恩

summary.en: Chinese President Xi Jinping is set to meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un in a rare visit to Pyongyang. This meeting occurs weeks after Xi held discussions with the leaders of the United States and Russia, two nations that significantly influence North Korea's foreign policy.
summary.zh: 中国国家主席习近平将罕见访问朝鲜，与朝鲜领导人金正恩会晤。此次会晤在习近平与美国和俄罗斯领导人会面数周后举行，这两个国家对朝鲜的外交政策具有重要影响。

body.en:
China's president Xi Jinping will meet Kim Jong Un next week in a trip to North Korea, in his first visit in nearly seven years, according to both countries' state media.

Xi will be in North Korea from 8 to 9 June at Kim's invitation. Xi last visited Pyongyang in 2019.

The visit comes weeks after Xi received US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin in Beijing - two countries that loom large over Pyongyang's foreign policy.

China is a key economic and political partner of North Korea, which faces sweeping international sanctions as a result of its nuclear weapons programme and alleged human rights violations.

China and North Korea share a 1,400km-long border and are bound by a defence pact - the only one China has with any country. It guarantees mutual support if either is attacked.

For Kim, the propaganda value of Xi's visit is self-evident. North Korea had improved its standing on the world stage after withstanding the pandemic and entering the war in Ukraine on the side of Russia.

Despite Beijing's close ties with both Pyongyang and Moscow, Xi is wary of the burgeoning alliance between Kim and Putin.

But Beijing, Pyongyang's largest trading partner, remains the main lifeline for Kim.

It is widely expected that Kim will seek more trade over the land border and more Chinese tourists to fill its newly built beach and ski resorts.

Kim has been proudly displaying his nuclear and missile arsenal. He has also been showing off the capital Pyongyang to visiting dignitaries. And he wants the world to know that it was all achieved without bending his knee to the US or engaging with the South.

Since Kim declared the end to reunification efforts with the South in December 2024, he had called South Koreans a sworn enemy and had cut all levels of communication with Seoul.

When the North Korean women's professional football team visited South Korea last month to face a South Korean football team, the freeze-out was in full display.

The North Koreans barely acknowledged the South Korean public who showed up to welcomed them at the airport and the stadium. They coldly shook hands with the South Korean players before the match then followed with rough and aggressive play.

Seoul is hoping Xi will play a mediator in this trip, nudging Pyongyang to resume dialogue with both Seoul and Washington.

South Korea's minister of unification Chung Dong-young said he believes that during Xi's meeting with Kim he will discuss resuming the US-North Korea talks.

While Beijing is a long-standing promoter of denuclearisation of the Korean Peninsula, it has significantly toned down this position in recent years.

body.zh: 据两国官方媒体报道，中国国家主席习近平将于下周访问朝鲜并会见金正恩，这是他近七年来的首次访问。 应金正恩邀请，习近平将于6月8日至9日访问朝鲜。习近平上次访问平壤是在 2019 年。 此次访问几周前，习近平在北京接见了美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京——这两个国家对平壤的外交政策至关重要。 中国是朝鲜的重要经济和政治伙伴，朝鲜因核武器计划和涉嫌侵犯人权而面临广泛的国际制裁。 中国和朝鲜有1400公里长的边界，并受防务条约约束——这是中国与任何国家签署的唯一防务条约。如果任何一方受到攻击，它保证相互支持。 对金正恩来说，习近平访问的宣传价值不言而喻。朝鲜在抵御疫情并与俄罗斯并肩参加乌克兰战争后，其在世界舞台上的地位得到了提高。 尽管北京与平壤和莫斯科关系密切，但习近平对金正恩和普京之间迅速发展的联盟持谨慎态度。 但平壤最大的贸易伙伴北京仍然是金正恩的主要生命线。 人们普遍预计金正恩将寻求更多的陆地边境贸易和更多的中国游客来填补其新建的海滩和滑雪胜地。 金正恩一直自豪地展示他的核武器和导弹武库。他还一直向来访的政要展示首都平壤。他希望世界知道，这一切都是在没有向美国屈服或与韩国接触的情况下实现的。 自从金正恩于 2024 年 12 月宣布结束与韩国的统一努力以来，他将韩国人称为死敌，并切断了与首尔的各个层面的沟通。 当朝鲜女子职业足球队上个月访问韩国迎战韩国足球队时，被冻结的情况得到了充分展示。 朝鲜人几乎没有承认在机场和体育场迎接他们的韩国公众。赛前他们与韩国球员冷冷握手，随后打得粗暴、咄咄逼人。 首尔希望习近平在这次访问中扮演调解人的角色，推动平壤恢复与首尔和华盛顿的对话。 韩国统一部长官郑东泳表示，他相信习近平在与金正恩会晤期间将讨论恢复美朝会谈。 尽管北京长期以来一直是朝鲜半岛无核化的推动者，但近年来它的立场已大大缓和。 据白宫称，在上个月的特习会期间，两位领导人重申了朝鲜无核化的共同目标。

reflection.en: This rare diplomatic meeting highlights the ongoing effort required to navigate complex international relationships. Even when nations hold differing views or interests, the pursuit of peace remains a vital endeavor. As Romans 12:18 reminds us, we are called to live at peace with everyone, as far as it depends on us.
reflection.zh: 这次罕见的外交会晤凸显了驾驭复杂国际关系所需的持续努力。即使各国持有不同的观点或利益，追求和平仍然是一项至关重要的事业。正如罗马书12:18提醒我们的，我们蒙召要尽力与众人和睦。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: China cracks down on soft porn, violence and materialism in viral micro dramas
title.zh: 中国打击病毒式微短剧中的软色情、暴力和拜金主义

summary.en: Chinese authorities are cracking down on micro dramas, which have become popular but are criticized for sensationalist content, including soft pornography, violence, and materialism.
summary.zh: 中国当局正在打击微短剧，这类短剧虽然广受欢迎，但因其内容常含软色情、暴力和拜金主义等煽情元素而受到批评。

body.en:
China has ordered provincial authorities to crack down on materialistic, violent and sexualised content in locally produced micro dramas.

The campaign targets content that portrays soft pornography, "distorted views on marriage and relationships" and "ostentatious displays of wealth", said China's National Radio and Television Administration.

It comes as part of a larger effort by the Chinese government to guide social norms, including by promoting marriages and discouraging harmful ideologies from spreading online.

Micro dramas, which are serialised, made-for-mobile clips, have exploded in popularity globally in recent years, but have drawn criticism for their often sensationalist content.

Many shows feature wild, fast-moving plot lines, about topics ranging from secret billionaire husbands to forbidden romances, that are designed to keep viewers glued to their screens.

There has also been no shortage of shows portraying excessive violence or sexualised characters.

China's media administration said in a statement this week that the media campaign is one of "great significance for creating a healthy content ecosystem" for the micro drama industry.

The campaign will address key issues including soft pornography, "materialism and ostentatious displays of wealth" and "distorted views on marriage and relationships."

It will also target "feudalistic themes, violent revenge content, vulgar titles and copyright infringement", the statement read.

Local authorities are expected to conduct spot checks on the work of their jurisdiction's production firms, which will be required to promptly rectify any issues that surface, said the media regulator.

It added that the administration will carry out its own inspections and improve its regulations based on the findings from the campaign.

Micro dramas have grown into a multi-billion dollar industry for China, attracting large audiences worldwide, including in other parts of Asia and even Africa.

Producers in countries like South Korea and the United States have invested in creating their own micro drama studios to tap the booming sector.

Last year, the sector's growth prompted the Chinese government to order that high-profile and sensitive micro drama productions needed to be approved by authorities.

Major Chinese platforms like WeChat and Douyin - the country's version of TikTok - also led crackdowns to remove sexually suggestive material, and took aim at micro dramas that promoted harmful ideologies including the endorsement of youth misconduct, vigilantism or materialism.

Under President Xi Jinping, Beijing has taken steps to influence social attitudes in China, including by promoting healthy relationships while discouraging the flaunting of wealth as the country grapples with several economic...
body.zh: 中国已下令省级当局严厉打击本地制作的微剧中的物质主义、暴力和色情内容。 中国国家广播电视总局表示，该行动针对描绘软色情、“歪曲婚姻观和感情观”以及“炫耀财富”的内容。 这是中国政府引导社会规范的更大努力的一部分，包括促进婚姻和阻止有害意识形态在网上传播。 近年来，微剧是一种连续播放的手机视频，在全球范围内迅速流行，但因其内容往往耸人听闻而受到批评。 许多节目都有狂野、快速发展的情节，主题从秘密的亿万富翁丈夫到禁忌的恋情，旨在让观众紧盯着屏幕。 也不乏描绘过度暴力或性化角色的节目。 中国新闻出版广电总局在本周的一份声明中表示，此次媒体宣传活动对于微剧行业“打造健康的内容生态系统具有重要意义”。 该活动将解决一些关键问题，包括软色情、“物质主义和炫耀财富”以及“对婚姻和人际关系的扭曲看法”。 声明称，它还将针对“封建主题、暴力复仇内容、粗俗标题和侵犯版权”。 媒体监管机构表示，预计地方当局将对其管辖范围内的制作公司的工作进行抽查，要求这些公司及时纠正出现的任何问题。 它补充说，政府将根据这次活动的结果进行自己的检查并改进其法规。 微剧已发展成为中国价值数十亿美元的产业，吸引了世界各地的大量观众，包括亚洲其他地区甚至非洲。 韩国和美国等国家的制片人已投资创建自己的微剧工作室，以开拓蓬勃发展的行业。 去年，该行业的增长促使中国政府下令，高调且敏感的微剧制作需要获得当局批准。 微信和抖音（中国版的 TikTok）等中国主要平台也开展了打击行动，删除性暗示内容，并针对宣扬有害意识形态（包括支持青少年不当行为、私刑主义或物质主义）的微剧。 在习近平主席的领导下，北京已采取措施影响中国的社会态度，包括在中国努力应对多项经济问题时促进健康的人际关系，同时阻止炫耀财富……

reflection.en: In a world saturated with media, it's easy to be drawn to content that is sensational or provocative. Philippians 4:8 encourages us to fix our thoughts on what is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, and admirable. This timeless wisdom offers a guide for discerning what we consume, shaping our minds and hearts towards what is truly good.
reflection.zh: 在一个媒体充斥的世界里，人们很容易被煽情或挑衅性的内容所吸引。腓立比书4:8鼓励我们思想那些真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事。这句永恒的智慧为我们如何选择所接触的内容提供了指引，帮助我们的思想和心灵转向真正美好的事物。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: ‘Unpredictable and extreme’: Asia braces for El Niño

summary.en: Weather models project a potentially strong El Niño this year, which could bring extreme weather like heatwaves to India, heavy rainfall to China, and agricultural damage across Southeast Asia. The UN has issued a warning for the world to prepare for its imminent return and the associated global impacts.
summary.zh: 天气模型预测今年可能出现强厄尔尼诺现象，这可能给受热浪袭击的印度带来灾难，使中国遭受暴雨，并损害东南亚的农业。联合国已警告世界必须为厄尔尼诺现象的迫近回归及其带来的全球影响做好准备。

body.en: Weather models project a potentially strong El Niño this year, which could spell disaster for heatwave-hit India, drench China and hurt agriculture across south-east Asia The UN has warned that the world must prepare for the imminent return of El Niño and the raised global temperatures and weather extremes it brings. The powerful natural weather pattern has an 80% chance of forming before September and a 90% chance before November, the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) said on Tuesday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 天气模型预测今年可能出现强烈的厄尔尼诺现象，这可能会给遭受热浪袭击的印度带来灾难，使中国遭受洪水侵袭，并损害整个东南亚的农业。联合国警告说，世界必须为即将到来的厄尔尼诺现象及其带来的全球气温升高和极端天气做好准备。世界气象组织 (WMO) 周二表示，这种强大的自然天气模式有 80% 的可能性在 9 月之前形成，90% 的可能性在 11 月之前形成。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As weather patterns become more extreme, the call to prepare for El Niño reminds us of the wisdom in foresight. Proverbs 27:12 encourages us to see danger and take refuge, acting prudently in the face of potential hardship. This wisdom applies not only to natural phenomena but also to how we steward our resources and communities for the future.
reflection.zh: 随着天气模式变得日益极端，为厄尔尼诺现象做准备的呼吁提醒我们预见性智慧的重要性。箴言27:12鼓励我们看见危险就藏身，在潜在的困境面前审慎行事。这种智慧不仅适用于自然现象，也适用于我们如何为未来管理资源和社区。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: UK car sales hit post-Covid high for May as Chinese EV makers gain ground
title.zh: 英国汽车销量创疫情后五月新高，中国电动汽车制造商崭露头角

title.en: Tiananmen dissident lambasts China on massacre anniversary
title.zh: 天安门异议人士在屠杀周年纪念日谴责中国

summary.en: On the anniversary of the Tiananmen Square massacre, Wu'er Kaixi, who played a leading role during the 1989 protests, spoke to DW about his personal loss and nearly four decades in exile.
summary.zh: 在天安门广场屠杀事件周年纪念日之际，1989年抗议活动中的主要人物吾尔开希向德国之声讲述了他的个人损失和近四十年的流亡生涯。

body.en:
On the anniversary of the Tiananmen Square massacre, Wu'er Kaixi, who played a leading role during the 1989 protests, spoke to DW about his personal loss and nearly four decades in exile.

Wu'er Kaixi has put on weight in the last 37 years and his greying hair no longer flops over his eyes in the style he affected as a student at Beijing Normal University in 1989, but some things have not changed.

He is, for instance, still on the list of student dissidents that the Chinese government identified as the ringleaders of the Tiananmen Square protests in those heady days when democracy seemed a possibility for China.

Now, 58 and living in Taipei, Kaixi is just as outspoken about the Chinese government, which has made it plain that he will never be granted amnesty and that he can never return home.

Speaking in Tokyo on Wednesday, a day before the anniversary of the brutal suppression of the demonstrations, Kaixi said, "What I have been trying to tell the world is the simple fact that China is a threat not only to peaceful dissenters in China, but also a direct threat to the entire civilization of mankind."

For too long, countries have looked the other way when Beijing has oppressed internal dissent, including ethnic minorities such as Tibetans and Uyghurs, and hoped to encourage China to become a responsible member of global society through engagement.

Other governments put trade and economic opportunities over human rights, he said, but nations appear to have realized their mistake.

"The US has had a pro-China policy that is appeasement," he said. "The US led and the rest of the world followed."

"China was allowed to join the World Trade Organization and the global trade system because it was hoped that this would lead to a civil society that would eventually give birth to democracy," he said.

That has not happened yet, he said, but at least President Donald Trump is approaching the situation from a different perspective, of a businessman who is willing to apply leverage.

"Japan, the US and every other country seem to have misunderstood China," he told DW. "They think China is led by ideology, by nationalism or communism, but that's wrong. The Chinese Communist Party is a criminal group that is driven by profit."

And while the Chinese leaders "talk about rejuvenation" and how taking control of Taiwan will benefit the nation — and a public fed on propaganda is roused to the party's aims — the reality is quite different, Kaixi said.

"They do not care about rejuvenating China; all they care about is adding another zero to their bank balances,” he said. "They are nothing but common thieves."

And he cautions other governments — including that of Germany — to be wary of investments that look like sound business propositions...
body.zh: 在天安门广场大屠杀周年纪念日，在 1989 年抗议活动中发挥主导作用的吾尔开希向德国之声讲述了他个人的损失和近四十年的流亡经历。 37年来，吾尔开希的体重有所增加，花白的头发不再像1989年在北京师范大学读书时那样垂在眼睛上，但有些事情并没有改变。 例如，在那些令人兴奋的日子里，当中国似乎有可能实现民主时，他仍然在中国政府认定的天安门广场抗议活动的头目学生持不同政见者名单上。 现年 58 岁、居住在台北的开西同样对中国政府直言不讳，中国政府明确表示他永远不会获得特赦，也永远无法回家。 周三，在残酷镇压示威周年纪念日的前一天，凯西在东京发表讲话时说，“我一直试图告诉世界一个简单的事实，即中国不仅对中国的和平异议人士构成威胁，而且对整个人类文明构成直接威胁。” 长期以来，当北京镇压藏族和维吾尔族等少数民族内部异见人士时，各国都视而不见，并希望通过接触鼓励中国成为全球社会负责任的一员。 他说，其他政府将贸易和经济机会置于人权之上，但各国似乎已经意识到自己的错误。 “美国一直奉行绥靖政策，”他说。 “美国领先，世界其他国家紧随其后。” “中国被允许加入世界贸易组织和全球贸易体系，因为人们希望这将带来一个最终诞生民主的公民社会，”他说。 他说，这种情况尚未发生，但至少唐纳德·特朗普总统正在从一个愿意施加影响力的商人的不同角度来处理这一情况。 “日本、美国和其他所有国家似乎都误解了中国，”他告诉德国之声。 “他们认为中国是由意识形态、民族主义或共产主义领导的，但这是错误的。中国共产党是一个受利益驱动的犯罪集团。” 凯西说，虽然中国领导人“谈论复兴”以及控制台湾将如何使国家受益，而且公众在宣传中被唤醒，了解党的目标，但现实却截然不同。 “他们不关心振兴中国；他们关心的只是在银行存款余额上再增加一个零，”他说。 “他们只不过是普通的小偷。” 他警告其他政府——包括德国政府——对那些看似合理的商业主张的投资要保持警惕……

reflection.en: For decades, dissidents like Wu'er Kaixi have carried the weight of speaking truth to power, enduring exile and personal loss for their convictions. Their steadfastness reminds us of the profound moral choice to prioritize conscience and justice, even when it means defying human authority.
reflection.zh: 几十年来，像吾尔开希这样的异议人士肩负着向权力说真话的重担，为他们的信念忍受流亡和个人损失。他们的坚定提醒我们，即使这意味着反抗人类权威，也要优先考虑良知和正义，这是一个深刻的道德选择。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

Sanmu Chen tried to tie a symbolic red thread to a street signpost in Causeway Bay, a shopping district close to a park that previously hosted an annual candlelight vigil on 4 June to commemorate those who died in the 1989 student-led protests. Continue reading...
body.zh: 纪念 1989 年杀戮的公共活动在香港变得越来越敏感 周三，一名香港行为艺术家试图纪念北京 1989 年天安门广场镇压的受害者，但很快就被便衣警察制止，这是香港言论自由萎缩的最新迹象。陈三木试图在铜锣湾的一个街道路标上系上一条具有象征意义的红线。铜锣湾是一个靠近公园的购物区，几十年来，铜锣湾每年都会在 6 月 4 日举办烛光守夜活动，以纪念在 1989 年学生领导的抗议活动中丧生的人们。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In Hong Kong, an artist's quiet act of remembrance for historical events was swiftly halted by authorities. This echoes the enduring tension between human laws and the call of conscience to honor truth and memory. When faced with conflicting demands, the biblical principle reminds us to obey God rather than human beings, upholding what is right in His sight.
reflection.zh: 在香港，一名艺术家为纪念历史事件而进行的安静行为迅速被当局阻止。这反映了人类法律与良心呼唤之间，在尊重真相和记忆方面的持久张力。当面对相互冲突的要求时，圣经原则提醒我们，顺从雅伟胜于顺从人，坚持在祂眼中看为正确的事。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: How China keeps North Korea's economy alive
title.zh: 中国如何维持朝鲜经济运转

summary.en: Pyongyang relies on China for 95% of its legitimate trade; hacking, arms deals and remittances also help it stay afloat.
summary.zh: 平壤95%的合法贸易依赖中国，此外，黑客攻击、军火交易和侨汇也帮助其维持经济运转。

body.en:
Xi Jinping is about to visit North Korea for the first time since 2019. Pyongyang relies on China for 95% of its legitimate trade; hacking, arms deals and remittances also help it stay afloat.

North Korea runs one of the most bizarre economies on the planet. Despite being one of only a handful of nations with nuclear weapons , its 2024 gross domestic product (GDP) was a paltry $26.6 billion (€22.9 billion).

This is about 70 times smaller than South Korea's $1.86 trillion economy and about a fifth of the annual revenue of the world's top-traded company, Nvidia.

Thanks to a centrally planned economy that prioritizes domestic production, North Korea is nowhere near as reliant on trade as your average free-market economy, partly due to international sanctions, introduced by the United Nations in 2017 over its nuclear weapons and ballistic missiles program.

The North's total imports and exports account for just a small fraction of GDP, versus the South, where international trade makes up around 80% of the economy, according to the World Bank.

You could say that China plays almost an exclusive role in North Korea's minimal reliance on trade .

According to the Washington-based think tank the National Committee on North Korea , Pyongyang depends on China for up to 95% of total trade and 85% of its exports.

Almost all imports also come from China. In 2024, North Korea's legitimate imports totaled just $2.33 billion — tiny by global standards.

With no domestic oil production, these deliveries from China include petroleum and other fuels and are essential in keeping the economy functioning, along with food, textiles, machinery, electronics and vehicles.

This gives Beijing enormous economic clout over North Korean leader Kim Jong Un . A recent report suggested that US President Donald Trump is now trying to leverage that muscle to bring Pyongyang back to the negotiating table over its contentious nuclear weapons program.

Chinese President Xi Jinping is scheduled to visit Pyongyang on June 8 and 9, according to state media in both countries. It will be Xi's first visit to North Korea since 2019. 

Legitimate exports from what the US labels a rogue state are even less impressive. According to the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency, North Korea's exports barely reached $360 million in 2024.

Those foreign sales are strikingly modest, with fake hair and wigs the country's only best seller, making up about 40% of exports, primarily to China, which then reexports them to the rest of the world.

title.en: Australia's fuel supply secured well into August as bowser pressure eases
title.zh: 澳大利亚燃油供应充足至八月，但油价压力或将卷土重来

summary.en: Australia's fuel supply is secure until August, providing some relief at the pumps. However, this ease may be short-lived as the government's fuel tax is scheduled to increase again, potentially bringing back price pressure.

body.en:
Australia has enough fuel reserves to last almost three months, as petrol prices at the bowser drop to near pre-Middle East war levels.

The stock includes 43 days' worth of petrol, 36 days' worth of diesel, and 30 days' worth of jet fuel, with billions of litres more fuel being shipped, Energy Minister Chris Bowen said on Saturday.

"Australia is doing very, very well in the face of the ongoing tension and challenges that every country in the world is facing with fuel supply," he told reporters.

"All three levels are more than on the 28th of February, when Iran was first bombed."

More than 90 ships arrived carrying fuel in May, about 10 more than the average monthly arrival of 81.

Another 50 are on their way, with 3.5 billion litres of fuel expected to be delivered over the next four weeks.

That consists of 1.8 billion litres of diesel, 512 million litres of petrol, 468 million litres of jet fuel, and 709 million litres of crude oil.

"We also have the situation now that we can say fuel is secure through June and July, and now well into August as well," Mr Bowen said.

Average petrol prices across the nation's largest cities have fallen to near pre-Iran conflict levels in the past week, but they're set to rise at the end of the month when the federal government's temporary fuel tax discount ends.

The average price of petrol on Wednesday was $173.30 cents per litre in Sydney, $175.60 in Melbourne and $176.20 in Brisbane, according to the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission.

On 20 February, about a week before the conflict in the Middle East escalated, the average price per litre was $165.20 in Sydney, $176.10 in Melbourne and $188.80 in Brisbane.

The day before the federal government temporarily cut the fuel excise by half on 31 March, the price was $257.40 in Sydney, $259.10 in Melbourne and $258.70 in Brisbane.

Diesel prices have also dropped, but they're still well above pre-conflict levels.

The average price of diesel per litre on Wednesday was $206.70 in Sydney, $214.50 in Melbourne and $214.20 in Brisbane.

That's down from $321.80 in Sydney, $324.40 in Melbourne and $322.70 in Brisbane on March 31, but higher than the average prices on February 20 of $174.30 in Sydney, $178.90 in Melbourne and $179.70 in Brisbane.

Mr Bowen confirmed the temporary 50 per cent cut to the federal fuel excise that reduced the tax on petrol and diesel by 26.3 cents per litre would end on June 30 as planned.

"But of course, we'll continue to monitor the situation, and we'll always act in the best interests of Australians, based on the evidence before us," he said.
